Open a shell on a box or in a project's directory, or run a command there.

Usage: termag ssh <box>[/<project>] [<ssh options>] [-- <cmd>]

termag flags go before <box>; everything after it goes to ssh. One <cmd> argument is a
shell command line, as with ssh; several are words passed through intact.
  termag ssh devbox/my-project -- claude -p "fix the failing test"
  termag ssh devbox/my-project -N -L 3000:localhost:3000

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
